name: Option payoff structures / Put-Call Parity / synthetic positions / strategy semantics

txoContractFacts.expirySettlement: Final settlement price based on simple average of underlying index values provided during the final 30 minutes before cash-market close on expiry date.

parity.preferredForwardForm: C - P = D(T) * (F - K), for same expiry/strike and a consistently defined forward/discount factor.
parity.spotCarryForm: C - P = S*exp(-qT) - K*exp(-rT) under simplified continuous-carry assumptions.
parity.txoInterpretation: Long Call - Short Put replicates a forward-like expiry payoff S_T-K for the same strike/expiry; it is not automatically identical to holding the cash index/ETF because financing, dividends/carry, basis and settlement definitions differ.

syntheticPositions.longForwardLike: Long Call + Short Put at same K,T
syntheticPositions.shortForwardLike: Short Call + Long Put at same K,T
syntheticPositions.longCallLike: Long underlying/forward-like exposure + Long Put under consistent carry convention
syntheticPositions.longPutLike: Short underlying/forward-like exposure + Long Call under consistent carry convention
syntheticPositions.guard: Use payoff equivalence, not execution equivalence. Margin, funding, spread, liquidity, settlement, exercise style and capital usage can differ.

strategyFamilies.rule: A strategy is a payoff transformation. It is not an alpha source unless entry state, IV/surface, path, costs and exit rules add validated information.

parityResidual.researchRole: First a quote/source-quality and cross-instrument consistency diagnostic; only later a market-state candidate.
parityResidual.formulaConcept: Observed call - put difference minus model-consistent discounted forward-minus-strike value.
parityResidual.nonArbitrageGuard: A nonzero mid-quote residual is not automatically executable arbitrage.

afterHours.issue: Cash index is not continuously trading while TXO/TX night trading continues.
afterHours.rule: After-hours parity should use a frozen forward/futures convention rather than silently carrying the last cash index as current spot.
afterHours.settlementGuard: TXO final settlement uses a cash-index averaging procedure; a futures price is a forward proxy, not the settlement object itself.

falsification: Test parity residual using executable bid/ask bands, not midpoints only.
Asynchronous quote placebo: widen synchronization window and measure apparent residual inflation.
Compare residual against quote spread, depth and zero-bid state; if residual is explained by illiquidity, classify DATA_QUALITY rather than alpha.
Separate regular-session and after-hours parity because underlying/forward observability differs.
Test whether strategy payoff metrics add anything beyond simpler Greeks/IV/skew/surface state.
Include transaction costs, margin/capital usage and theta/vega path before economic-value claims.
No strategy optimization from realized returns until entry/exit rules are frozen.
prohibitedClaims: Long call + short put always equals owning Taiwan stocks.
Mid-quote parity deviation equals free arbitrage.
A straddle with positive Gamma is automatically profitable.
Defined-risk spread is lower risk without specifying horizon, gap risk and max loss.
Strategy backtest may choose strikes/expiries after seeing returns.

maturityDecision.reason: Contract style, parity/synthetic semantics, execution-equivalence limits, after-hours basis issues and falsification hierarchy are defined. No Taiwan PIT executable-leg/OOS evidence for L3.

exactNext: Use the same permitted TAIFEX parent option rows as D12-16 to build parity-quality diagnostics before outcomes.
Freeze synchronized quote/executable-band rules and forward source for regular versus after-hours sessions.
Compare parity residual to bid/ask/liquidity before treating it as market information.
Add strategy payoff engine only as deterministic mechanics QA; no outcome-driven strategy ranking.
Accumulate source-attested independent dates before L3/Formal consideration.
